title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
reason: Departure of Nvidia's CEO is a major market-moving event with significant implications for AI infrastructure and funding.

sources.summary: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.

title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh-oh, Jensen!
reason: Reveals potential failure of US export controls, a critical geopolitical and regulatory issue for AI.

sources.summary: New research shows the most advanced AI models from China were trained on banned Nvidia chips.
